title: Bora Employer Pipeline Requirement Record
description: Canonical structured representation of one job requirement extracted from a job description. The record must preserve source wording and must not upgrade preferred, contextual, or ambiguous language into a mandatory requirement.

requirement_id.description: Permanent identifier for this requirement within the analyzed job.

job_id.description: Job_ID of the job record from which this requirement was extracted.

text.description: Normalized statement of the requirement. It must faithfully represent the source and must not introduce a stronger claim than the job description supports.

category.description: Functional category assigned to the requirement. Exact category vocabulary is an implementation choice and is not locked by the Blueprint.

importance.description: Whether the job description supports treating the requirement as mandatory, preferred, or unclear. These states come directly from the Blueprint requirement-extraction rule.

seniority_implication.description: What, if anything, the requirement implies about expected seniority. Null when the source does not support a seniority conclusion.

technology.description: Technologies explicitly associated with this requirement. Empty array when no technology is stated. Technology mention alone must not make the requirement mandatory.

experience_level.description: Experience level explicitly stated or clearly supported by the requirement, such as a stated number of years. Null when not specified.

domain.description: Business or technical domain explicitly connected to the requirement. Null when no domain is supported by the source.

relevance.description: How material this requirement is to evaluating the role. This vocabulary is a proposed implementation choice, not a Blueprint-defined enum.

source_text.description: Exact or faithfully captured source wording from the job description that supports this requirement.

source_location.description: Location of the supporting wording within the job description, such as Qualifications, Responsibilities, Preferred Qualifications, or another identifiable section. Null only when the source structure does not provide a usable location.

source_semantic_role.description: SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_QUALIFICATION_VIEW_V1: where and how the employer positioned this requirement, independent of `importance`. Computed deterministically by src/requirement_source_role.py from source_text/source_location; never supplied directly by structured extraction input. Not a substitute for `importance` (MANDATORY/PREFERRED/UNCLEAR remains a separate, orthogonal dimension) and never itself a hard-blocker gate -- qualification eligibility is always derived, never read from this field directly by consuming code.

source_semantic_role_basis.description: Deterministic, human-readable explanation of which signals (section-heading category, content shape, prerequisite-language override, duplication override) produced source_semantic_role. Auditable provenance, not a free-form summary.

explicit_prerequisite_language_present.description: True when source_text contains explicit prior-possession/prerequisite language (e.g. "must have", "required experience", "minimum N years", "demonstrated/proven ability", "prerequisite", "certification required"). Drives the prerequisite-language override in src/requirement_source_role.py.

duplicated_under_requirements.description: True when this requirement's source_text is a near-exact-wording match (conservative containment, not semantic similarity) for another requirement in the same job whose source_location is classified as a Requirements/Qualifications heading. Drives the duplication override in src/requirement_source_role.py.

source_semantic_role_classifier_version.description: Identifies which classifier version produced source_semantic_role/source_semantic_role_basis, for auditable lineage (currently SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_CLASSIFIER_V1).
